_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: FiveM
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Cfx.re's multiplayer server for GTA V (FiveM) and Red Dead Redemption 2 (RedM), with txAdmin if you want it. Needs a free license key from Cfx.re.
startup: if [ -z "{{FIVEM_LICENSE}}" ]; then echo "FiveM needs a license key from portal.cfx.re. Set License key in Startup, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; a=/home/container/alpine; c=(); [ "{{TXADMIN_ENABLE}}" = 1 ] || c=(+exec server.cfg); exec $a/opt/cfx-server/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 --library-path "$a/usr/lib/v8/:$a/lib/:$a/usr/lib/" -- $a/opt/cfx-server/FXServer +set citizen_dir $a/opt/cfx-server/citizen/ +set sv_licenseKey "{{FIVEM_LICENSE}}" +set steam_webApiKey "{{STEAM_WEBAPIKEY}}" +set sv_maxclients {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +set gamename "$([ "{{TXHOST_GAME_NAME}}" = redm ] && echo rdr3 || echo gta5)" "${c[@]}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# FiveM. Downloads the chosen FXServer build for Linux from Cfx.re (the
# recommended one by default) and the standard resources. server.cfg, your
# resources and txAdmin's data are never touched; FXServer is replaced only
# once the new build has arrived whole.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
artifacts=https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || fail "Cfx.re publishes FXServer for x86-64 Linux only."
want="${FIVEM_VERSION:-recommended}"
case "$want" in
recommended | latest | optional | critical)
    url=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" https://changelogs-live.fivem.net/api/changelog/versions/linux/server | jq -r --arg k "${want}_download" '.[$k] // empty') ||
        fail "Cfx.re's build list can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -n "$url" ] || fail "Cfx.re lists no $want build right now. Reinstall to try again later."
    ;;
*)
    url="$artifacts/$want/fx.tar.xz"
    curl -fsIL -A "$ua" -o /dev/null "$url" ||
        fail "Cfx.re has no build $want. Set Version to recommended, or to a build's full name such as 7290-a654bcc2adfa27c4e020fc915a1a6343c3b4f921."
    ;;
esac
[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ] || url="$DOWNLOAD_URL"
name=${url%/fx.tar.xz}; name=${name##*/}

if [ -x alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer ] && [ "$(cat alpine/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$url" ]; then
    echo "FXServer $name is already installed."
else
    rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/x"
    echo "Downloading FXServer $name"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$build/fx.tar.xz" "$url" || fail "The download from Cfx.re failed. Reinstall to try again."
    # Cfx.re publishes no checksums, so check the archive is whole.
    xz -tq "$build/fx.tar.xz" || fail "The download from Cfx.re was damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xJf "$build/fx.tar.xz" -C "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer" ] || fail "FXServer $name's download has no server in it. Choose another version."
    echo "$url" > "$build/x/alpine/.raptor-version"
    rm -rf alpine && mv "$build/x/alpine" alpine
fi

# The standard resources (chat, spawn manager, map manager...), added only
# where you don't have them.
mkdir -p resources
rm -rf "$build/data"
if git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/citizenfx/cfx-server-data.git "$build/data"; then
    for r in "$build/data/resources"/*; do
        [ -e "resources/${r##*/}" ] || cp -a "$r" resources/
    done
else
    echo "The standard resources can't be downloaded right now, so they weren't updated."
fi

if [ ! -f server.cfg ]; then
    cat > server.cfg <<'CFG'
# FiveM server settings: https://docs.fivem.net/docs/server-manual/setting-up-a-server/
# The port, name and max players are set from the server's variables at
# every start, and the license key and Steam key on the command line.
endpoint_add_tcp "0.0.0.0:30120"
endpoint_add_udp "0.0.0.0:30120"

ensure mapmanager
ensure chat
ensure spawnmanager
ensure sessionmanager
ensure basic-gamemode
ensure hardcap

sv_scriptHookAllowed 0
sets tags "default"
sets locale "en-US"
sv_hostname "A FiveM server"
sv_maxclients 48
CFG
fi
mkdir -p logs
echo "Installed FXServer $name."

variables.name: License key
variables.description: Your server's license key, free from portal.cfx.re. The server won't start without one.

variables.name: Game
variables.description: fivem for GTA V, or redm for Red Dead Redemption 2.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once: up to 48, or more with OneSync and a key that allows it.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: recommended (the default), latest, optional, critical, or a build's full name such as 7290-a654bcc2adfa27c4e020fc915a1a6343c3b4f921. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Steam Web API key
variables.description: A Steam Web API key, for Steam sign-in in resources, or none.

variables.name: Use txAdmin
variables.description: Run txAdmin, Cfx.re's web dashboard for managing the server, on the txAdmin port instead of starting server.cfg directly.

variables.name: Port for txAdmin
variables.description: The port txAdmin's web dashboard listens on; add it as an allocation.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to an fx.tar.xz to install instead of Cfx.re's build, which only staff can set.
